name: Yarzion Vell's species
description: The Jedi Yarzion Vell was a member of a sentient species which could have red or green skin, red eyes, black hair, and pointed ears. When Vell returned to his home planet, he had a skin-scribe of the same species tattoo him with runes from his ancestor's language that spelled the name of his greatest teacher—his Jedi Master, Lulad—in accordance with the planet's tradition.
